title: Login service discovery document, contract v1 (DRAFT v1-d3)
description: GET /.well-known/openid-configuration. Labels per contract/README.md. Fields and fixed values: [SRC: PLAN §3.1 L106]. Listener: front [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-1]; also on 8084, same bytes and headers [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-31].

issuer.description: Real: https://login.<domain>/ [SRC: LD §4.5 L214]. Stand-in: path contains /standin [SRC: PLAN §3.5].

token_endpoint.description: Served on back channel 8084 [SRC: PLAN L109]. URL under the public issuer; clients never take it from discovery, they use their configured back-channel base URL [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-3].

revocation_endpoint.description: Served on back channel 8084 [SRC: PLAN L110]. URL under the public issuer; clients take it from config [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-3].

jwks_uri.description: Path /.well-known/jwks on the front listener [SRC: PLAN L107; TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-1].

subject_types_supported.description: Required by OIDC Discovery 1.0 §3 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-4].

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_values_s.description: For private_key_jwt: RS256 only [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-21].

revocation_endpoint_auth_methods_support.description: Same as the token endpoint [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-21].

authorization_response_iss_parameter_sup.description: RFC 9207; iss on every authorization response [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-17].

not.description: Not in v1: userinfo [SRC: PLAN L123]; front/back-channel logout [SRC: PLAN §1.3 L60]; introspection, scopes/claims/prompt values not published [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-4].

$comment: additionalProperties true so the real service may add standard fields [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-4]. The stand-in publishes exactly the properties listed here (the 'standin_exact_keys' $def); contract tests assert that exact key set [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-4].

standin_exact_keys.description: Stand-in only: exactly these keys, applied in addition to the root schema [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-4].
